audience: marketing teams running promotions in ViralSweep

useCases.title: Review active promotions for a brand
useCases.text: Find the account brand, then read its active promotions and their scheduled start and end times.

useCases.title: Find an entrant and review referral counts
useCases.text: Search a promotion by email address and read a page of entrants with their entry totals and referral counts.

useCases.title: Review existing winners and prize titles
useCases.text: Read winners already recorded for a promotion, optionally filtering by date, and inspect their prize titles.
